messages.author: fbd8d3b2f7340829
messages.subject: Missing packages after Rattle install
parts:
Every time the rattle is installed to a new computer with install.packages("rattle", dep=c("Suggests")) there are several packages that are missing.

You'd get an error message when executing certain function and need to load missing packages. Sometimes Rattle suggest installing the package, more often you see the error on console.

Here are some packages that I needed to install manually:
latticeExtra
gWidgets
rggobi
stabledist (also installing the dependency ‘FMStable’)
biclust
Deducer (also installing the dependencies ‘JavaGD’, ‘rJava’, ‘JGR’)
digest
gtable
proto
munsell
labeling
png
caTools

This is just a quick list from the fresh install.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Missing packages after Rattle install
parts:
The packages you list seem to mostly be dependencies of dependencies - I thought "Suggests" would capture them but perhaps not. rggobi is in the Rattle Suggests list so it is odd that this would not be installed. By the way, Deducer has been removed from the latest Rattle (3.0.2) due to CRAN policy and regular rJava crashes when loaded with RGtk2.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
